sql: SELECT name, type FROM sqlite_master ORDER BY name
SELECT 'items_g2' t, main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL) prc_nn, SUM(prc_usd IS NOT NULL) usd_nn, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL) only_prc, SUM(prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL) only_usd FROM items_g2
SELECT COUNT(*) n_all, SUM(main_cat IS NULL) null_mc FROM items_g2;
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_usd,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(prc_usd, prc/100.0)), 6) avg_cov,
  ROUND(AVG(prc_usd), 6) avg_usd_only,
  ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0, 6) avg_prc_only,
  MIN(prc) min_prc, MAX(prc) max_prc, MIN(prc_usd) min_usd, MAX(prc_usd) max_usd,
  SUM(prc <= 0) nonpos_prc, SUM(prc_usd <= 0) nonpos_usd
FROM items_g2
WHERE prc IS NOT NULL OR prc_usd IS NOT NULL;
SELECT ref_id, prc, prc_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE (prc IS NOT NULL) <> (prc_usd IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 5;

SELECT
 (SELECT MAX(prc) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL) max_prc_whenusd,
 (SELECT MIN(prc) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL) min_prc_nousd,
 (SELECT MAX(prc) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL) max_prc_nousd,
 (SELECT ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0,4) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL) avg_prc_nousd_usd,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc < 50000) low_nousd,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc >= 50000) ge500_nousd;
SELECT ref_id, title, prc, prc_usd, main_cat, brand, currency_hint FROM (SELECT i.*, NULL AS currency_hint FROM items_g2 i) WHERE prc_usd IS NULL ORDER BY prc DESC LIMIT 8;
SELECT COUNT(*) rows_ge500, SUM(prc_usd IS NULL) null_usd_ge500 FROM items_g2 WHERE prc >= 50000;
SELECT COUNT(*) mismatch FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc <> prc_usd*100;
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(prc_usd, prc/100.0)) AS avg_price_usd, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL OR prc_usd IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) n, MAX(ABS(prc - prc_usd*100)) max_absdiff, MAX(ABS(prc - ROUND(prc_usd*100))) max_absdiff_rounded FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc <> ROUND(prc_usd*100);
